digest.component_or_area: Scoped finite-pass fuse for coordinator failure handling
propositions: Endpoint fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two distinct tickets
Provider fuse opens only when failing outcomes span >= 2 distinct endpoints of the same provider, in addition to the three-consecutive-outcome threshold
A matching success resets the consecutive state for that scope; independent scopes retain and continue their own state

Eligible exhausted outcomes are keyed off budget-exhaustion provenance (plan_next_retry action='exhausted' or 'defer' at cap), never off physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, or diagnostic text
Open-fuse outcomes return explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata and do not execute matching remaining plans
